item.title: 3 inmate deaths at Connecticut prisons under investigation
item.description: NEW HAVEN, Conn. (WTNH) — The Connecticut Department of Correction (CT DOC) is investigating three recent deaths of inmates at state prisons. On Feb. 1, Andrey Desmond died after being found unresponsive in his cell, according to CT DOC. Desmond had been serving a five-year sentence stemming from the assault of state Rep. Maryam Khan.
